definitions.explanation: adding extra information or details to make something more complete

examples.japanese: {補足|ほそく}{説明|せつめい}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please give us a supplementary explanation.

examples.japanese: {一点|いってん}{補足|ほそく}があります。
examples.english: I have one thing to add.

examples.japanese: {資料|しりょう}の{最後|さいご}に{補足|ほそく}{情報|じょうほう}を{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I added supplementary information at the end of the document.

notes:
FORMATION:
{補|ほ} (supplement, compensate) + {足|そく} (add, suffice) → add to supplement

VERB FORM:
{補足|ほそく}する (to supplement, to add)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {補足|ほそく}{説明|せつめい} (supplementary explanation)
- {補足|ほそく}{情報|じょうほう} (supplementary information)
- {補足|ほそく}{資料|しりょう} (supplementary materials)

RELATED WORDS:
- {追加|ついか} (addition)
- {付|つ}け{足|た}す (to add on)
- {補|おぎな}う (to supplement, to make up for)
- {添|そ}える (to add, to attach)

USAGE:
Commonly used in meetings, presentations, and written documents when adding clarifying information. The phrase "{一点|いってん}{補足|ほそく}ですが" (Just one thing to add...) is frequently heard in business settings.
